narrative.details: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck.  His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Defiant Orc Head to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is the head of Marg Nighteye! As I feared, he is dead.

Look at the wound on his neck! Could a weapon have made that ragged cut, or did some beast slay our agent?

This is a mystery we must solve, adventurer. We must discover if Marg's death was at the hands of the Alliance!
narrative.requestItemsText: You have another matter to report, adventurer?
